title: Putting Together
short: Put two small groups together and count them all.

blocks.html: When we put two groups together, we count them all. 2 cats and 1 more cat make 3 cats!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: 2 cats and 1 cat together. How many cats?

blocks.html: Putting together makes more. Count them all.

blocks.title: Two plates
blocks.q: One plate has 2 crackers. The other has 2. How many in all?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Use small numbers, up to 5, and real things. “You have 2 blocks. I give you 1. How many now?” Let your child count them all. No need to write anything. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Join two small piles of blocks and count.
Add a raisin to a plate of 3.
Act out a story: 2 bears, 1 more comes.
